class CountUp:
    def __init__(self, stop): self.current, self.stop = 0, stop
    def __iter__(self): return self
    def __next__(self):
        if self.current >= self.stop: raise StopIteration
        self.current += 1
        return self.current
print(list(CountUp(3)))
